sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Manufacture of Absorbable Polyglycolic Acid Braided Sutures

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid: English Common Law foundation (post-1980 Constitution and Companies legislation), French Civil Law influence, and recognized Customary Law
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: No bilateral income tax treaty (DTA) with any OECD member is currently in force; Vanuatu maintains a zero-income-tax regime for International Companies
Australia–Vanuatu Tax Information Exchange Agreement (TIEA, in force)
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus, in force for Vanuatu)
WTO Membership (acceded 2012) with binding MFN and national treatment commitments

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act [Cap. 222] (No. 7 of 1992, as amended, including the 2014 amendments prohibiting bearer shares and strengthening beneficial ownership transparency); Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 13 of 2018 (as amended); Financial Transactions Reporting Act No. 1 of 2002; Vanuatu Financial Services Commission Act No. 10 of 1993 [Cap. 233]; VFSC AML/CFT Rulebook and Beneficial Ownership Guidance; FATF Recommendations as implemented through the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) located within the VFSC.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Certified Copy of Passport of each Ultimate Beneficial Owner, Director, and Authorized Signatory
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in country of origin of the individual

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Corporate Extract of each corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company Registry / Registrar of Companies in the jurisdiction of incorporation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney (POA) appointing the Vanuatu licensed registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter confirming identity, banking history, and source of funds of the beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Originating bank of the beneficial owner

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all Ultimate Beneficial Owners, directors, and authorized signatories against (i) the UN Security Council Consolidated List, (ii) OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List, (iii) UK/EU consolidated financial sanctions lists, and (iv) Vanuatu domestic sanctions and FIU directives. Mandatory Politically Exposed Person (PEP) checks for both domestic and foreign PEPs under the AML/CFT Act No. 13 of 2018 and VFSC guidance, with enhanced due diligence and ongoing monitoring for high-risk PEPs. For the ISIC 3250 surgical consumables manufacturing scope, additional export-control and dual-use screening of end-user documentation is recommended in connection with SWIFT LC and TT Wire payment rails. Screening evidence must be documented by the licensed registered agent prior to incorporation and retained for a minimum of five years.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: VFSC Online Company and Business Names Registration Portal (Vanuatu Financial Services Commission)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The official record language for International Companies is English. Vanuatu also recognizes French and Bislama as official languages, but the registered name of an International Company must be expressed in Latin script and follow English corporate naming conventions. The name must end with 'Limited', 'Ltd.', 'Corporation', 'Inc.', or another suffix approved by the VFSC indicating limited liability. Transliteration of foreign-language names into Latin characters is permitted only where the resulting name is not identical or deceptively similar to an existing registered name and is otherwise approved by the VFSC.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bank, Banking, Trust, Trustee: prohibited unless a financial services license is held under the Banking Act / Trust Companies Act
Insurance, Assurance, Reinsurance: prohibited unless licensed under the Insurance Act
Fund, Finance, Financial Services, Investment, Broker, Exchange: prohibited without prior VFSC financial services licensing
National, Government, Royal, Commonwealth, University, Chamber of Commerce: require prior ministerial approval
Hospital, Clinic, Pharmaceutical, Pharmacy, Medical: require prior approval from the Ministry of Health and may be rejected for an offshore manufacturing entity
Qualifying words implying misleading government connection, public authority status, or professional licensing must be avoided
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant may immediately re-apply once with a revised, non-conflicting name and payment of the applicable re-filing fee. If the VFSC maintains its refusal, the applicant or its licensed registered agent must file a formal written administrative appeal with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission within 30 days of the rejection notice, citing grounds of non-conflict and non-prohibition under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222] and, where relevant, the Companies Act [Cap. 191]. If the administrative appeal is denied, the applicant may seek judicial review before the Supreme Court of Vanuatu. A name reservation may be renewed for successive 30-day windows upon application before expiry and payment of the renewal fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for administrative and statutory address purposes only. Every International Company must continuously maintain a registered office and a licensed registered agent physically located in Vanuatu. The actual manufacturing and assembly operations for ISIC 3250 (absorbable polyglycolic acid braided sutures / surgical suture needle assembly) may be conducted entirely outside Vanuatu without a local operating premise. A virtual office bundled with the licensed registered agent's physical Port Vila address satisfies the statutory address requirement, provided all official communications are directed through the registered agent.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low: quantified probability of unannounced on-site inspection is approximately 2-5% per annum for a standard, low-risk non-resident International Company under VFSC supervision. The probability increases to 20-30% if unusual transaction volumes, high-risk counterparties, or AML/CFT red flags are detected, triggering enhanced diligence by the Vanuatu FIU under the AML/CFT Act No. 13 of 2018.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff per VFSC published fee schedule (VUV 50,000 equivalent)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for standard low-risk client onboarding

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary Public and consular / foreign affairs authentication office in country of origin
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing notarial and consular tariff schedule in issuing jurisdiction

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal drafting of Memorandum and Articles of Association, UBO declarations, registered office consent, and board resolutions for incorporation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for standard International Company formation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: VFSC administrative certificates, including Certificate of Incorporation, Certificate of Good Standing, and certified extracts
Annual economic substance notification and compliance declaration filing support (first year)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registered agent / licensed corporate compliance provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for offshore company annual maintenance

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Courier, translation, and bank introduction / correspondent verification support for SWIFT LC and TT Wire payment rails
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Third-party disbursement at cost plus prevailing market benchmark

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap 222] (Vanuatu), ss 6-8 (incorporation), ss 9-12 (powers and articles), ss 15-16 (shares), ss 19-20 (registered office and agent), ss 45-47 (directors and officers)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), International Companies Division, Port Vila
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Certificate of Incorporation issued upon filing of Form IC-1 (Application for Incorporation) and executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for an International Company; at least one issued share required, permitted in any currency, and no escrow account or capital deposit mandate applies under the International Companies Act
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the subscriber's subscription to 100 ordinary shares of no par value, as recorded in the share register, is approved and confirmed, and the Corporate Secretary is directed to issue share certificates. RESOLVED FURTHER that the registered office in Port Vila, Vanuatu, maintained by the licensed registered agent, is adopted as the Company's statutory registered office. RESOLVED FURTHER that the named individuals are appointed as directors, the Corporate Secretary is appointed, and each officer is authorised to resign in favour of successors. RESOLVED FURTHER that the directors are authorised to open bank accounts, approve corporate banking mandates, execute agreements, and file all returns required under the International Companies Act.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Corporate Affairs / Registry Intake Unit
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit two proposed company names for clearance to ensure no conflict with the National Companies and International Companies registers; verify that the name does not imply banking, insurance, fiduciary, or exchange activity requiring a sectoral licence; obtain written name approval.
required_dossiers: Certificate of incorporation of any existing corporate promoter, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a name is rejected for similarity or prohibited terms, submit an alternative name or file an administrative appeal with the VFSC Registrar within 14 days, supported by a statutory declaration of originality.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Registered Agent in Vanuatu (VIPA-registered corporate services provider)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in accordance with Schedule 1 of the International Companies Act; include permitted objects for manufacturing surgical suture needle assembly, share capital structure with no-par-value shares, director authority, and indemnity clauses; documents to be signed by at least one subscriber.
required_dossiers: Notice of registered office and registered agent appointment
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC queries any clause (e.g. ultra vires objection), file a revised consolidated amendment to the articles and re-submit with a cover memo explaining the construction.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Submission to the VFSC Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission, International Companies Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the executed Form IC-1, Memorandum and Articles, and registered agent consent, together with payment of the incorporation fee (55,000 VUV approximately USD 470); the registered agent certifies compliance with the International Companies Act and submits the dossier electronically and in hard copy.
required_dossiers: Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Registered agent consent form and registered office undertaking
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is rejected or queried, the registered agent files a corrective schedule within 10 business days; VFSC provides written reasons and the re-submission is expedited under the Registry's correction procedure.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Post-Incorporation Corporate Acts
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission and the Company's first board of directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon VFSC issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation, convene a first board meeting (or pass a written unanimous resolution), adopt the incorporation acts, issue share certificates, approve the corporate seal, settle registered office records, and open the corporate bank account with a licensed Vanuatu bank.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If bank onboarding is delayed, obtain a VFSC Certificate of Good Standing and a board resolution confirming beneficial ownership to satisfy Know Your Customer requirements; escalate to the banking ombudsman if refusal persists.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Filings and Annual Governance Compliance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission and Vanuatu Customs/TRB for tax registration confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the annual return with VFSC, confirm exemption from Vanuatu direct taxes (International Companies Exemption Order), and register for a Business Licence with the Vanuatu Municipal Authority where physical operations occur; maintain minute books, share registers, and corporate records at the registered office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: For late filing penalties, pay the compounding VFSC late fee and submit a compliance statement within 7 days; for Business Licence objections, cure by providing the environmental and industrial clearances described in the licensing module.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA) and the Department of Industry, Ministry of Trade and Commerce; sector supervision by the Ministry of Health for medical device imports where applicable
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Industrial Manufacturing Business Licence under the Business Licence Act [Cap 251] and VIPA Investment Approval Certificate for Foreign Investment

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vanuatu Environmental Protection Agency (VEPA), Department of Environmental Protection, Ministry of Climate Change
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 2 Screening Level (Broad-Scale Manufacturing) requiring an Environmental Compliance Registration Certificate; full EIA Report not mandated for low-emission surgical suture needle assembly, unless hazardous chemical use or wastewater discharge triggers Category 3
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharges must comply with pH 6.0-8.5 and COD below 100 mg/L pursuant to Vanuatu Pollution Control Regulations; volatile organic compound emissions from isopropyl-alcohol degreasing must remain below 5 tonnes per year; segregated sharp waste and polyglycolic acid residues must be handled as clinical waste and sterilised or incinerated under the Waste Management Act before disposal.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate required from the Vanuatu Fire Service (Vanuatu Police Force Fire Division) covering extinguisher placement, means of egress, and chemical storage separation; structural load inspection clearance for cleanroom/assembly equipment issued by the Public Works Department; occupational health and safety registration under the Health and Safety at Work Act, including first-aid provision, machine guarding for needle-grinding units, and eye-wash stations; workplace medical clearance for workers engaged in fine-needle assembly operations.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – corporate registry and IC licensing; Department of Inland Revenue (DIR), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management – VAT and customs revenue. Portals: https://www.vfsc.vu and https://www.gov.vu (DIR e-services gateway).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A Vanuatu International Company (IC) is incorporated electronically via a licensed VFSC agent and receives a Certificate of Incorporation containing the VU Company Registration Number; no separate income-tax TIN is issued because ICs are exempt from Vanuatu tax. For VAT, if voluntary or mandatory registration is triggered, the IC files VAT Registration Form (VAT-1) with DIR, attaching the certificate of incorporation, registered office details, UBO identification, and projected annual turnover; DIR issues a VAT Account Number within approximately 10–15 business days.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax and has no check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election regime. The IC may elect in its constitutional documents to operate under the International Companies Act with an International Company (exempt) status; no election alters tax treatment.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Vanuatu Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value Added Tax Act No. 11 of 1998 (Cap. 245)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 4,000,000 annual taxable turnover (compulsory); voluntary registration available for turnover below this threshold where the person is carrying on a taxable activity
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, digital stamping, or API e-invoicing mandate currently applies. A regular VAT invoice with prescribed content (invoice number, date, supplier/recipient VAT ID, goods description, VAT-exclusive value, VAT amount and rate) is required for all taxable supplies; records must be kept for seven years.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to goods exported from Vanuatu by the supplier within 28 days of invoice/payment, evidenced by a Customs export declaration and transport documentation, and to services supplied to a non-resident outside Vanuatu or directly connected to exported goods. For a Vanuatu IC conducting offshore medical-device assembly without local taxable activity, zero-rating is structurally immaterial because the supply is outside the territorial scope of Vanuatu VAT; if an IC elects voluntary VAT registration, the same export zero-rating conditions apply.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading or House Airwaybill
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIR may audit export zero-rating claims and may revoke zero-rating where documentary evidence or foreign exchange repatriation is not in place within the 180-day benchmark. The consequence is assessment of VAT at 12.5%, with default interest of 2% per month and penalties of up to 200% of the tax payable; fraudulent claims are criminally prosecutable with fines and imprisonment, and refunds received are clawed back for four years under the VAT Act and Proceeds of Crime Act.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), established under the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act [Cap 282], is the sole monetary and exchange-control authority, administering the Exchange Control Act [Cap 57] as substantially liberalized in 2006, together with the Ministry of Finance and Economic Management.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vanuatu Vatu (VUV) is fully convertible for current-account transactions and largely free for capital-account transactions. International Companies (ICs) under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] may hold, borrow, and remit funds in any foreign currency without RBV prior approval. Profit and capital remittances are unrestricted for non-resident ICs, subject only to a valid VFSC Certificate of Good Standing and an annual compliance return. Practical friction arises not from statutory controls but from correspondent-bank due diligence on VUV-denominated wires; therefore USD or AUD clearing accounts are the recommended treasury vehicle.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory surrender requirement exists. Exporters may retain 100% of foreign-currency proceeds offshore or onshore in external accounts. Obligation is limited to statistical reporting: monthly BOP-01 return to RBV for aggregated receipts exceeding VUV 10 million equivalent, and an annual survey for related-party trade flows. No mandatory conversion to VUV applies; where domestic VUV settlement is required, conversion is executed at the RBV-published mid-rate plus a commercial margin.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account in USD/AUD with dedicated Trade Finance and SWIFT MT103/MT700 desk
Corporate Current Account in EUR/USD, optimized for EU distributor collections and L/C issuance
Capital Escrow Account in VUV for limited domestic working-capital and utility settlements
Regional Collection Account for Pacific-island distributor receivables in AUD

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low feasibility. Vanuatu has no electronic-money-institution (EMI) licensing category; only deposit-taking institutions licensed under the Financial Institutions Act [Cap 356] may lawfully hold client funds. Foreign digital EMIs cannot clear VUV and face closed correspondent routes; their use for receivable factoring or interim float creates AML red flags and potential unlicensed-banking exposure under VFSC supervision. Direct licensed-bank rails are the sole compliant and operationally viable path.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical attendance is mandatory for at least one director and the ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) at a face-to-face onboarding interview in Port Vila, conducted by the bank's compliance officer. Remote video onboarding is permitted only for a second director or non-signatory officer, subject to a notarized electronic-video attestation. The board resolution authorizing signatories must be executed before a Vanuatu-licensed lawyer or notary, and the foreign Certificate of Incumbency must be apostilled and translated into English.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Historical bearer-share structure or incomplete UBO register on the IC
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: VFSC Certificate of Registered Owner; current beneficial-ownership register extract; notarized declaration of no outstanding bearer instruments; apostilled memorandum and articles of association; VFSC Certificate of Good Standing dated within 30 days.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk procurement jurisdictions for PGA (polyglycolic acid) raw material, e.g., China or India
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Supplier ISO 13485 certificate; third-party KYC report on the supplier; SGS or Bureau Veritas pre-shipment inspection certificates; purchase order cross-referenced to customs declarations; evidence of end-use manufacturing contracts.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Rapid pass-through of trade funds without visible economic substance in Vanuatu
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Audited purchase orders for surgical-suture assembly; Bill of Lading evidencing shipment of assembly equipment; production-site lease contracts; employment records of assembly managers; audited financial statements of the IC.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Entity-name confusion with offshore investment-fund or SPV vehicles
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of Incorporation (IC-01); VFSC Certificate of Good Standing; tax-exemption certificate under the International Companies Act; bank-to-bank reference letter from an existing trade-finance bank.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Unlimited foreign-currency equity injection is permitted without RBV prior approval. Execute via MT103 using remittance field 70 narrative: 'EQUITY INJECTION PER BOARD RESOLUTION DATED [DD-MON-YYYY] – VU_IC_ISIC_3250'. The bank will require a board resolution, updated certificate of incumbency, and an EDD questionnaire for each single wire above USD 50,000. Cumulative monthly inflows exceeding VUV 50 million equivalent must be reported to RBV in the BOP-01 statistical return within 10 business days.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary rail for raw-material procurement is an irrevocable Commercial Letter of Credit issued via SWIFT MT700 from the ANZ or Bred account, with settlement against presentation of shipping documents through the advising bank in the supplier jurisdiction. Running-account supplier payments below USD 10,000 use MT103 with purpose narrative 'TRADE SETTLEMENT – RAW MATERIALS FOR SURGICAL SUTURE ASSEMBLY'. Final-product disbursements from buyers settle through reverse MT103 collections; no central-bank approval is required for any outbound trade payment.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: No onshore deliverable VUV forward or NDF market exists; treasury policy mandates natural USD-offset hedging by denominating revenues and raw-material costs in USD.
Offshore non-deliverable VUV forward quoted by ANZ and Westpac Australian desks, permissible for hedging projected VUV operating-cost exposure where approved by RBV as a permitted derivative.
USD/EUR cross-currency swap executed via Bred Bank's Paris or New Caledonia desks to hedge EUR-denominated EU distributor receipts.
Vanuatu IC-issued zero-coupon USD promissory notes as a synthetic funding hedge for raw-material invoice exposure.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual renewal application and licence fee payment for International Company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before each anniversary of the date of incorporation; VFSC accepts submissions made within the 60 days preceding the anniversary date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment incurs a penalty of 25% of the annual fee if paid within 30 days after the deadline; on each further 30-day period an additional penalty accrues. Non-payment beyond 90 days triggers VFSC strike-off proceedings, and restoration requires payment of all arrears, penalties, and a restoration fee.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Concurrent with the annual renewal filing; must be submitted on or before the anniversary date of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file the annual UBO confirmation may result in a written warning, a monetary penalty of up to VUV 10,000, and daily default penalties; continued non-compliance can lead to administrative strike-off of the International Company.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory audit for a Vanuatu International Company under the International Companies Act; no statutory turnover or asset thresholds apply. An audit becomes mandatory only if required by the company's own articles, by shareholder resolution, or if the company obtains a regulated financial services licence.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No statutory accounting framework is prescribed for International Companies; records may be prepared under IFRS or another recognised foreign GAAP for management purposes only. No financial statements are filed with the VFSC.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Annually, the registered agent must obtain from the company a confirmation that the beneficial ownership register reflects current ownership, including any share transfers during the year. Share transfers affecting UBOs must be recorded in the register and reported to VFSC at the time of the transfer; the annual confirmation is an additional verification of full compliance.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book of directors and shareholder meetings

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not required; if voluntarily engaged, USD 4,000 - 8,000 for a licensed auditor

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% (Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax, no capital gains tax, no branch profit tax, no payroll tax, and no social security contribution tax at the national level; it is a zero-direct-taxation jurisdiction).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Zero effective national income tax rate built into the statutory base. Additionally, an International Company (IC) incorporated under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] is statutorily exempt from all Vanuatu taxes, duties, levies, and stamp duty on its income, assets, shares, and transactions (s.33 International Companies Act). No discretionary tax holidays exist. Indirect tax exposure is limited to value-added tax at the statutory 12.5% rate (VAT Act 1998), which is zero-rated for exported goods, and municipal business-license fees if a local physical operation is maintained.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form IC-AR — International Company Annual Return, filed with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) through the VFSC online e-Registry portal; the licensed resident agent countersigns and submits.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 30 days after each anniversary of incorporation; the annual government franchise fee is payable simultaneously. VFSC applies a progressive late-filing fee (10-20% of the annual fee per month elapsed, capped at 100%) and may strike off the company after sustained default.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full registered name and unique VFSC company number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the exact registered name; no tax-residency election is available because the IC is statutorily exempt.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 2 - Date of incorporation and anniversary
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registration date and the recurring annual filing date.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Confirm the anniversary month to avoid late fees while management is outside Vanuatu.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical address of the licensed registered agent in Port Vila.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A continuous physical registered office is mandatory; a PO Box alone is insufficient.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statement of business purpose; use ISIC 3250 / NAICS 339112 covering manufacture of absorbable polyglycolic acid braided sutures, surgical needles, and suture-needle assembly.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Declare that no business is transacted with Vanuatu residents and no Vanuatu-sourced revenue is earned, preserving the s.33 tax exemption.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Share capital structure, par value, and paid-up amounts.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No minimum capital requirement applies; disclose issued capital in USD-equivalent terms.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names, nationalities, residential addresses, and appointment dates of directors and the secretary.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors are permitted; maintaining at least one natural-person director supports substance evidence.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Identification of every individual holding 10% or more of shares or control rights, per the BO register.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Keep the beneficial-ownership register with the registered agent and update it within the statutory period; non-compliance is a criminal offence.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Reliance on s.33 International Companies Act; confirmation of no local trading, land holding, or banking activity in Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach a concise description of the cross-border supply chain to evidence absence of Vanuatu-source income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Self-assessment of physical presence, local employees, local expenditure, and CRS Financial Institution classification.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Confirm that the IC is not a CRS Financial Institution unless it conducts banking, custody, or investment activity.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Countersignature of the licensed Vanuatu agent confirming completeness and payment of the annual fee.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The agent countersignature is mandatory; issue instructions before the anniversary date.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: progressive late fee of 10-20% of the annual franchise fee per month elapsed (capped at 100%). Non-payment beyond six months: administrative strike-off and dissolution. Beneficial-ownership false declarations: fines up to VT 1,000,000 and imprisonment up to two years under the Companies (Amendment) Act 2013.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VAT Return Form 1 (VAT Act 1998), filed with the Vanuatu Department of Customs and Inland Revenue (DCIR), VAT Division.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Monthly, or every two months for small taxpayers where approved by the Commissioner.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Return and payment due on or before the last calendar day of the month following the end of the taxable period; exports of surgical suture products are zero-rated and typically create a refund credit position.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Value of Vanuatu local supplies subject to output tax.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: An IC without local Vanuatu sales enters zero and must not report export revenue as taxable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Value of exported surgical sutures and needles supported by shipping documentation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Retain bills of lading, export customs entries, and SWIFT/TT receipts for at least seven years to substantiate the 0% rate.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: VAT borne on local purchases, professional fees, and overheads evidenced by valid VAT invoices.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only invoices addressed to the IC bearing the Vanuatu VAT registration number are creditable; foreign-incurred VAT gives no credit.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 4 - Net VAT payable or refundable
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Output tax less input tax; zero-export businesses normally show a refundable position.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: File even in nil or refund positions; the DCIR uses this form to verify the zero-rated export chain.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing or late payment: fixed penalty of VT 10,000 per unfiled return plus monthly compounding interest on unpaid duty; deliberate understatement attracts a civil penalty of 100-200% of the tax shortfall and criminal prosecution with fines up to VT 10,000,000 and imprisonment up to seven years.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - Vanuatu imposes no dividend withholding tax, no branch remittance tax, no distribution tax, and no capital gains tax on share disposals. An International Company may repatriate profits to non-resident shareholders by dividend, loan repayment, intercompany settlement, or management fee without any Vanuatu tax cost.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has no comprehensive double-taxation agreement currently in force; a DTA with Australia was negotiated but never ratified, and Vanuatu maintains only Tax Information Exchange Agreements (TIEAs) with Australia, New Zealand, and a small number of other states. Because the domestic withholding tax rate is already nil, no Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) application or treaty-relief filing is required for outbound dividends, interest, or royalties. The IC simply records the remittance in its financial statements. If a future DTA enters into force for inbound claims, the expected protocol would be a VFSC certificate of incorporation plus a VFSC letter of tax-exempt status, submitted to the foreign tax authority.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rate on outbound interest and IP royalties: 0%; no deemed-dividend rules, no thin-capitalisation limitation, and no notional deduction rules apply. Payments from the IC for technology licences (absorbable PGA suture manufacturing know-how), loans from parent entities, and intercompany management fees may be remitted free of Vanuatu tax. The only practical obligation is to document such payments on arm's-length terms in IC books so that foreign CFC/transfer-pricing rules in the shareholder's residence jurisdiction do not recharacterise the Vanuatu exempt entity.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable - Vanuatu has no transfer-pricing statute, no Local File / Master File requirement, no Country-by-Country reporting regime, and no advance pricing agreement mechanism. The closest analogous registration threshold is the VAT registration threshold of VT 5,000,000 (approximately US$41,000) of annual taxable turnover for physical supplies made in Vanuatu; no filing threshold applies for purely cross-border intercompany transactions.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP (Comparable Uncontrolled Price - preferred for standard medical consumables where external comparables are available)
Resale Price (resale-minus - viable for group distribution entities handling suture products)
Cost Plus Method (appropriate for contract manufacturing and surgical needle-assembly contracts)
TNMM (Transactional Net Margin Method - the default profit-basis method for routine offshore service and procurement entities)
Profit Split Method (applicable to integrated R&D and supply-chain arrangements involving unique intangibles)
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu does not operate a Gulf-style Economic Substance Rules code, but as an OECD Inclusive Framework member it applies CRS reporting, beneficial-ownership registers, and VFSC administrative substance expectations. The IC must maintain adequate substance: a licensed resident registered agent, a physical registered office in Vanuatu, and available books and records. The VFSC annual return includes an economic-substance self-assessment; enhanced review applies to relevant activities of banking, insurance, shipping, fund management, financing and leasing, headquarters, holding company, IP holding, and distribution/service-centre. Pure manufacturing of surgical sutures and needle assembly (ISIC 3250) is not a listed relevant activity, but real operational direction (board minutes, intercompany agreements, a Vanuatu bank account, and financial statements) must be preserved to avoid shell-company recharacterisation, foreign CFC inclusion, and VFSC strike-off.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Breach of International Company tax-exempt perimeter (local trading)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the IC to sell product, provide services, or hold land for the benefit of Vanuatu residents, thereby crossing from lawful offshore exempt activity into local business prohibited under the International Companies Act [Cap 222].
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Invalidation of the s.33 International Companies Act exemption; recharacterisation as an ordinary Vanuatu company; imposition of VAT at 12.5% on local supplies; municipal business-licence assessment; and VFSC strike-off proceedings. Regulatory fines apply under the non-compliant conduct provisions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly authorise local business may be personally liable for unpaid VAT and civil restitution to the company; VFSC may issue a prohibition order barring management of any Vanuatu entity for up to five years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining a brass-plate IC with nominee directors, no physical office, no accounting records, undisclosed beneficial owners, and no genuine business direction, used merely as a conduit for profits from the suture supply chain.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: VFSC refusal to accept the annual return, public default listing, administrative strike-off and dissolution, asset-freezing orders on Vanuatu bank accounts, and red-flag reporting to OECD and APG peer jurisdictions under TIEA exchange mechanisms.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the licensed registered agent face fines and imprisonment for false declarations under the Companies (Amendment) Act 2013; the Vanuatu Supreme Court may order restitution, costs, and a travel ban while the dissolution is investigated.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Channeling suspicious Swift/TT wire payments into the IC account without customer due diligence on ultimate beneficial owners, structuring transactions below reporting thresholds, evading international sanctions, or engaging in unlicensed securities or forex dealing in parallel with the medical-device business without the required VFSC Financial Dealers Licence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act 2007 (as amended): Supreme Court confiscation and freezing orders, statutory financial penalties against the corporate entity, and criminal fines plus imprisonment for individuals; unlicensed financial dealing additionally triggers VFSC enforcement and criminal prosecution.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Limited liability is pierced: directors, compliance officers, and the registered agent are personally liable for money-laundering and false-declaration offences, with custodial sentences of up to 15 years, personal asset confiscation, travel bans, and mutual-assistance extradition within the APG network.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to file the VFSC annual return and pay the government franchise fee for more than six months after the anniversary, or failure to lodge VAT returns where local taxable activity exists.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Progressive late fees of 10-20% per month (capped at 100% of the annual fee); automatic strike-off and dissolution; VAT non-filing adds the fixed per-return penalty and monthly compounding interest on arrears; the registered agent is prohibited from continuing to act for the company.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors remain civilly liable for debts incurred after dissolution; VFSC may certify personal liability for outstanding fees and tax arrears, and directors may be barred from incorporating new Vanuatu entities for up to five years.
